data.character_group_1|mappings[0].descriptio: A girl who aspires to be an idol, inheriting the will of her older sister Mana Nagase. When the group first formed she avoided communicating with others and was sometimes isolated. But she grew while overcoming hardships with the members, and now she is the one leading everyone.
data.character_group_1|mappings[1].descriptio: A girl who lives by intuition, unpredictable and innocent. She joined the agency upon being scouted, with the simple motive of it looking fun. But she was moved by Mana's attitude as an idol and began sincerely aiming to become an idol like her.
data.character_group_1|mappings[2].descriptio: A girl who became an idol to support her best friend Kotono. She is imaginative and shows curiosity in unexpected places. She once lost confidence for lacking any strengths as an idol, but she struggles on daily, drawing strength from supporting Kotono.
data.character_group_1|mappings[3].descriptio: A picture-perfect honor student who also serves as student council president, and the coordinator of Tsuki no Tempest. At debut she agonized over her own overprotectiveness toward her imouto Chisa, but now they trust each other and walk their own paths.
data.character_group_1|mappings[4].descriptio: A clumsy, easily teased young lady who worships Mana. Pressured by her parents to study abroad, she visited the agency half in flight. After that she overcame her habit of running away and gained her parents' formal approval to work, and now she livens up Hoshimi Production.
data.character_group_2|mappings[0].descriptio: A shy and timid girl. She aspired to be an idol to change herself. At first she could only follow behind her older sister, but through idol activities she gradually gained confidence and resolved to walk on her own feet beside her sister.
data.character_group_2|mappings[1].descriptio: Everyone's onee-san and the coordinator of SUNNY PEACE. The first idol to join Hoshimi Production, who knew Mana in life. She once nearly gave up on her dream, but unwilling to betray those who believed in her, she pursues idol activities with strong resolve.
data.character_group_2|mappings[2].descriptio: A skilled dancer talented enough to win a dance competition. She aims to become an idol so her parents will recognize dance as her profession. When she first joined she demanded a high level from the members, causing friction, but she found a way to lead everyone with her skill.
data.character_group_2|mappings[3].descriptio: An innocent idol who received a heart transplant from Mana Nagase. She gained popularity with a singing voice just like Mana's, but gradually came to question standing on stage with Mana's voice. Overcoming her anguish, she chose to part ways with Mana's voice and move toward the future.
data.character_group_2|mappings[4].descriptio: A quiet idol otaku who is a little bad at smiling. When she first joined she worried about her talking ability and weak emotional expression, and lost confidence as an idol. But she hit it off with Chisa, who had the same worries, and grows day by day while supporting each other.
data.character_group_3|mappings[0].descriptio: The absolute center of TRINITYAiLE. Though hailed as a genius, her brilliance is backed by overwhelming effort. Her dignified demeanor makes her seem flawless, but she also has a side that suddenly falls asleep or is a picky eater.
data.character_group_3|mappings[1].descriptio: A former child prodigy actress who aspired to be an idol for the sake of her family. She is so mature you wouldn't think she's a middle schooler, and has a knack for remembering the faces and names of everyone she meets. Among trusted friends, however, she shows a childish innocence fitting her age.
data.character_group_3|mappings[2].descriptio: From Kyoto, the always-calm coordinator of TRINITYAiLE. Her father is the president of a major company and her mother a famous actress. Captivated by Rui, she acts with Rui as her first priority. This is well known among fans, and many are drawn to Yu's devoted nature.
data.character_group_4|mappings[0].descriptio: A mood maker of LizNoir who loves making people smile. She has been friends with Kokoro since their training-school days and often gets teased. She has solid skill but often messes up at crucial moments and gets scolded by Rio.
data.character_group_4|mappings[1].descriptio: The always-calm brain of LizNoir with little fluctuation in emotion. Her bond of trust with Rio is very strong; even when forced to suspend activities, she rejected proposals for new members and kept waiting for her. She is skilled enough to copy a dance after seeing it once.
data.character_group_4|mappings[2].descriptio: The friendly, excitable vanguard of LizNoir. She and Ai acknowledge each other, but she tends to put bad ideas in people's heads. Showing a charm and cuteness LizNoir never had before, she brings a fresh wind to the group.
data.character_group_4|mappings[3].descriptio: The unshakable center of LizNoir, greedy for victory. She was once forced to suspend activities by the sense of loss after Mana, whom she was to face in the Grand Prix finals, passed away first. Since the addition of new members her feelings have changed and she has grown.
data.character_group_5|mappings[0].descriptio: A legendary idol known as the 'Miracle of Falling Stars.' She passed away only a year and a half after her debut. Yet in that short time she set numerous legends and records, and even after her death she continues to influence many idols.
data.character_group_6|mappings[0].descriptio: A little-devil idol with extreme mood swings but outstanding sense. A former hugely popular model who has graced the covers of many magazines since childhood. She has a high need for approval, with over 2 million social media followers.
data.character_group_6|mappings[1].descriptio: A charismatic natural genius with a superb figure who knows nothing of effort. The center of IIIX, a former top model who has even appeared at Paris Fashion Week. For a certain reason she is extremely attached to money.
data.character_group_6|mappings[2].descriptio: A theorist who works hard, making use of abundant experience and knowledge. She was once a member of a popular idol duo that suddenly disbanded just before reaching the BIG4. The brain of the group, generally gentle but with a vindictive side.
data.character_group_aqo|mappings[0].descript: A second-year at Uranohoshi Girls' High School and the founder of Aqours. The youngest of three sisters, her family runs an inn. Friendly and competitive. With her innate cheerfulness and forcefulness she draws those around her in one after another.
data.character_group_aqo|mappings[1].descript: A second-year who transferred from Akihabara, Tokyo into Chika's class. She seems mature and composed but is actually a scatterbrain who jumps to conclusions and misunderstands things.
data.character_group_aqo|mappings[2].descript: A second-year at Uranohoshi Girls' High School and Chika's classmate. A high diver with national-team-level ability. The type to move before thinking. Her father is a ferry captain, and she too hopes to become a captain someday.
data.character_group_goch|mappings[0].descrip: A girl boarding at the Rabbit House café. She loves cute and fluffy things, and dotes on Chino like an imouto.
data.character_group_goch|mappings[1].descrip: The only daughter of Rabbit House. She has a cool personality but doesn't dislike Cocoa...!? A reliable girl who knows a lot about coffee.
data.character_group_mku|mappings[0].descript: A pop and cute virtual singer loved across generations. She performs on stages unrelated to the VENUS program, and her bright, beautiful singing voice captivates people all over the world.
data.character_group_mku|mappings[1].descript: (Provisional) A pop and cute virtual singer loved across generations. She performs on stages unrelated to the VENUS program, and her bright, beautiful singing voice captivates people all over the world.
